title: Indya z'Umusaza zitari zitezwe
intro: Mu bibanza vyeranda vy’Inzu ya Allah, umusavyi w’Imana ageze mu zabukuru yarashikiwe n’akabanga gakomeye karengeye ivyo umuntu yari yiteze vyose. Uwo muntu yiyemeje, amaze igihe kirekire amaze imyaka y’ubuvyeyi busanzwe, yariboneye ikintu kidasanzwe cahishura imbabazi zitagira aho zigarukira z’Ubumana. Ico kibazo kiri mu guhishura uwo mwanya wibagiwe mu buzima bw’abahanuzi.
clues: Abantu banje bari bazwi kw’izina rya Isirayeli, abakomoka ku sekuruza w’imiryango akomeye wa kera.
Namara amajoro yose nsenga, npfukamira imbere y’Umukama wanje mu rusengero.
Narahawe umuhungu mu busaza bwanje, ingabirano ntazohagarika guhimbaza Allah.
Ikigeragezo canje cari kirimwo ukuvumbura ivyo kurya vyabonetse ku mutima mutoyi nari ndiko ndavyitaho.
Nari umuhanuzi yitwa Zakariyya, nari nashinzwe kwitwararika Mariyamu mu gisagara ca Bayt al-Maqdis.
Inyishu iri mu murongo aho Allah yemeye Mariyamu, akamuronsa ivyo afungura.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Umuhanuzi yavuganye na Allah ataco yishisha

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kuronka ivyo kurya vyatanzwe mu buryo bw'akabanga ku ward y'abakiri bato
Ukwamamaza ihanga ryaranse ubuyobozi buva ku Mana .
Gutabwa mu mwobo n’abantu biwe bwite .
Kwakira ihishurirwa biciye mu vyo yeretswe .
trial.answer: Kuronka ivyo kurya vyatanzwe mu buryo bw'akabanga ku ward y'abakiri bato

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Ukwemererwa n’Imana n’ikigongwe ku bihebeye ugusenga .
Umuhungu yavutse mu busaza nkuko vyasezeranywe .
outcome.answer: Ukwemerwa n’Imana n’ikigongwe ku bihebeye ugusenga .

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
